expectations.text: Uses fb.nonNullable.group() or NonNullableFormBuilder (not plain FormBuilder.group with nullable controls)
expectations.evidence: Line 127: `inject(FormBuilder).nonNullable` then line 130: `this.fb.group(...)` -- uses the nonNullable property on FormBuilder.

expectations.text: FormControls are typed -- no 'any' types, no UntypedFormControl/UntypedFormGroup
expectations.evidence: No UntypedFormControl or UntypedFormGroup imports. All controls created via nonNullable FormBuilder produce FormControl<string>.

expectations.text: Includes a custom async validator for username that returns Observable<ValidationErrors | null>
Async validator passes the third argument position or uses asyncValidators option on the FormControl
expectations.evidence: Line 136: `[usernameAvailableValidator(this.userService)]` as the third array element in the fb.group shorthand.

expectations.text: Template uses @if (not *ngIf) for conditional error display
Submit button is disabled when form is invalid
